## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to bind the protected sign to its [`gmeow:Trademark`](../classes/gmeow-Trademark.md) relator — the mark-side player of the trademark.

### Avoid when

- Avoid binding several marks to one trademark (it is functional — each protected mark has its own [`Trademark`](../classes/gmeow-Trademark.md) relator) and avoid using it as the entity-to-trademark link, which is [`gmeow:hasTrademark`](gmeow-hasTrademark.md).

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:trademarkMark`](gmeow-trademarkMark.md) once per [`Trademark`](../classes/gmeow-Trademark.md) (functional) to the [`gmeow:Mark`](../classes/gmeow-Mark.md) it protects.

### Examples

- ex:blackcatTM [`gmeow:trademarkMark`](gmeow-trademarkMark.md) ex:blackcatMark.
